name: Hap Seng Plantations Holdings Berhad
overview: 2026年公司没有宣布新的业务扩张、出售或新业务线，主要动态是持续披露油棕鲜果串（FFB）、毛棕油（CPO）和棕仁（PK）的月度及季度产量。截至2026年9月30日止季度，CPO产量同比增5.04%，FFB产量同比增5.12%，棕仁产量同比增9.25%；2026年前9个月CPO累计产量同比增7.01%。此外，公司于2026年3月披露一项重大诉讼，并派发2026财年第一次中期股息2仙。
overview_en: In 2026, the company did not announce any new business expansion, divestment or new business line. Its main updates were continued monthly and quarterly disclosures of fresh fruit bunch (FFB), crude palm oil (CPO) and palm kernel (PK) production. For the quarter ended 30 September 2026, CPO output rose 5.04% year-on-year, FFB output rose 5.12% and PK output rose 9.25%; cumulative CPO production for the first nine months of 2026 rose 7.01% year-on-year.

segments.name: 油棕种植
segments.note: 公司持续披露FFB月度及季度产量，2026年前9个月FFB累计产量453,282吨，同比增6.18%。
segments.note_en: The company continued to disclose monthly and quarterly FFB production; cumulative FFB output for the first nine months of 2026 was 453,282 tonnes, up 6.18% year-on-year.

actions.title: DISCLOSURE ON QUARTERLY PRODUCTION
actions.text: 2026年第三季度FFB产量158,089吨，同比增5.12%；前9个月累计453,282吨，同比增6.18%。
actions.text_en: FFB production for Q3 2026 was 158,089 tonnes, up 5.12% year-on-year; cumulative nine-month output was 453,282 tonnes, up 6.18% year-on-year.

actions.title: DISCLOSURE ON QUARTERLY PRODUCTION
actions.text: 2026年第二季度FFB产量142,197吨，同比减1.44%；上半年累计295,193吨，同比增6.76%。
actions.text_en: FFB production for Q2 2026 was 142,197 tonnes, down 1.44% year-on-year; first-half cumulative output was 295,193 tonnes, up 6.76% year-on-year.

actions.title: DISCLOSURE ON QUARTERLY PRODUCTION
actions.text_en: FFB production for Q1 2026 was 152,996 tonnes, up 15.70% year-on-year.

segments.name: 鲜果串加工
segments.note: 公司持续披露CPO及棕仁月度及季度产量，2026年前9个月CPO累计产量101,166吨，同比增7.01%。
segments.note_en: The company continued to disclose monthly and quarterly CPO and PK production; cumulative CPO output for the first nine months of 2026 was 101,166 tonnes, up 7.01% year-on-year.

actions.title: DISCLOSURE ON QUARTERLY PRODUCTION
actions.text: 2026年第三季度CPO产量35,057吨，同比增5.04%；棕仁产量7,335吨，同比增9.25%；前9个月CPO累计101,166吨，同比增7.01%。
actions.text_en: CPO production for Q3 2026 was 35,057 tonnes, up 5.04% year-on-year; PK output was 7,335 tonnes, up 9.25% year-on-year; cumulative nine-month CPO output was 101,166 tonnes, up 7.01% year-on-year.

actions.title: DISCLOSURE ON QUARTERLY PRODUCTION
actions.text: 2026年第二季度CPO产量32,259吨，同比减1.59%；棕仁产量6,864吨，同比减2.00%；上半年CPO累计66,109吨，同比增8.09%。
actions.text_en: CPO production for Q2 2026 was 32,259 tonnes, down 1.59% year-on-year; PK output was 6,864 tonnes, down 2.00% year-on-year; first-half cumulative CPO output was 66,109 tonnes, up 8.09% year-on-year.

actions.title: DISCLOSURE ON QUARTERLY PRODUCTION
actions.text: 2026年第一季度CPO产量33,850吨，同比增19.27%；棕仁产量7,325吨，同比增15.14%。
actions.text_en: CPO production for Q1 2026 was 33,850 tonnes, up 19.27% year-on-year; PK output was 7,325 tonnes, up 15.14% year-on-year.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 公司披露一项重大诉讼，并宣派2026财年第一次中期股息2仙。
segments.note_en: The company disclosed a material litigation and declared a first interim dividend of 2 sen for FY2026.

actions.title: HSPLANT - Notice of Book Closure
actions.text: 宣派2026财年第一次中期股息2仙，除权日2026年9月9日，派发日2026年9月23日。
actions.text_en: Declared a first interim dividend of 2 sen for FY2026, with ex-date 9 September 2026 and payment date 23 September 2026.

actions.title: MATERIAL LITIGATION
actions.text: 公司于2026年3月19日公告一项重大诉讼。
actions.text_en: The company announced a material litigation on 19 March 2026.
